issue.title: history and list commands are largely redundant

summary.text: The verifier found 11 tests that passed before the fix and fail after it, including test_base_list, the test_list_with_* tests, test_base_help, test_base_help_history, test_base_cmdenvironment, the redirection tests, and two transcript tests. Look at these failures first: removing the list command and merging it into history likely changed help output and transcripts, so decide whether these test…
